name: Dual USB Sound Fob Interfaces
notes: Use this profile for two separate CM108/CM119 USB radio interfaces.
Both interfaces must provide duplex USB audio and remain connected to their original physical USB sockets.
The preparation stage discovers both USB audio devices and records their named ALSA device identifiers.
The preparation stage assigns the corresponding C-Media HIDRAW device to each radio port.
Numeric ALSA card indices are diagnostic information only and are not stored as the SvxLink audio device.
PTT and COS control may subsequently be selected as HIDRAW, GPIOD or serial.
